title: CEDUR - German IBD Registry
official: Long-term Observation of IBD Patients, a Nationwide German IBD Registry "CEDUR"
summary: The CEDUR registry systematically collects real-world data on inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients in Germany. The registry aims to assess quality of care, disease activity, treatment effectiveness, safety, and pharmacoeconomic aspects under routine clinical conditions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Crohn Disease Ulcerative Colitis Indterminate Colitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other gastrointestinal disorders than above
